prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a high ponytail bound at three intervals, clean swept-back roots and a bare forehead; costume silhouette a fitted base layer with flowing panels of projected light floating around her like a gown — a silhouette spread in light; design idea interlocking loom-card perforations form the structural fastenings of the projected silk panels; face heart-shaped face; expression relaxed closed lips.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Japanese woman — the personification of the city of Kyoto — one woman who IS Kyoto as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; heart-shaped face; almond-shaped eyes of natural size; amber eyes; straight brows of natural fullness; a straight nose with a slim bridge; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; a high ponytail bound at three intervals, clean swept-back roots and a bare forehead; glossy jet-black hair.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a wrap dress of smart silk brocade where gold-thread flowers and drifting clouds slowly weave and re-weave themselves across the cloth, a long translucent sash over one shoulder running with rows of tiny glowing punched holes like the pattern cards of an old card-driven loom, and fine gold filaments threaded through her enormous braid.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a fitted base layer with flowing panels of projected light floating around her like a gown — a silhouette spread in light. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: interlocking loom-card perforations form the structural fastenings of the projected silk panels.
Colours: maple crimson, matcha green and dusk indigo — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a slender weaving shuttle of white ceramic and gold, trailing a glowing thread of light; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Kyoto two centuries from now, a far-future city that chose to stay low: the thousand-year grid of the old capital glows as lines of soft light seen from the sky, the long rows of preserved wooden townhouses now have fine lattices woven of warm light, sky gardens and groves of softly glowing bamboo rise between them, the great station has grown into a canyon of glass and light running across the south of the city, summer platforms of light float over the shallow, clear river, and quiet flying vehicles glide low over the basin, its three ring mountains dark against a clear, starry sky.
This card: high on the great stairway inside the station's canyon of glass and light at night, bridges of light crossing the open atrium above her and the glowing grid of the old capital beyond the glass.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: feet planted naturally; shuttle hand held beside her waist, free hand open beside her hip.
Setting detail: sparse soft-lit lattice bridges recede behind her without obscuring her silhouette.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

generation.note: Original PNG not uploaded; checksum retained. No regeneration.
